sampleAnswers.energy: A slow Saturday walk after the rain. The air smelled like wet leaves, and I didn't rush anywhere.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.lead: Soft Boring Weekly is a small weekly-review product. This page explains what we collect, why, and how long we keep it.
Privacy.s1Body: Soft Boring Weekly (softboring.com) is operated as an independent site. If you have a privacy question, contact us through the email on your account or the operator listed on the public site.
Privacy.s2Body: Account: email and a hashed password. Reviews you save (the six answers, optional feeling, locale, timestamps). Optional Soft Wall notes, comments, and stickers you choose to share. Billing identifiers from Stripe if you subscribe or buy stickers (we do not store full card numbers). Session and guest cookies so the app can stay signed in or keep unclaimed drafts in this browser. Server logs needed to run the service, including password-reset links if email is not configured.
Privacy.s3Body: We use this data to provide the weekly review, history, Soft+ features, Soft Wall, password reset, optional weekly reminders, and customer support. We do not sell personal data. We do not use reviews for advertising profiles.
Privacy.s4Body: We use an httpOnly session cookie when you log in, a guest cookie for unclaimed reviews, and an admin cookie for the separate /admin backend. Analytics may run on public pages if a measurement ID is configured. You can use the product as a guest without creating an account; guest reviews stay in that browser until claimed.
Privacy.s5Body: Stripe processes payments. If we send email, we use Resend or an SMTP provider you configure. Hosting and backups are on the operator’s server (SQLite on disk). Shared Soft Wall content is visible to Soft+ members you do not personally know; sharing is off by default.
Privacy.s6Body: We keep account and review data until you delete the account (or an operator deletes it for you). You can take a note off Soft Wall at any time. You can turn weekly reminders off on the account page. To request deletion or a copy of your data, sign in and contact the operator. This policy may be updated; the date above will change.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.lead: These terms are a simple contract for using Soft Boring Weekly. If you do not agree, please do not create an account.
Terms.s1Body: Soft Boring Weekly lets you write a short weekly review and, with a paid Soft+ plan, unlock unlimited history, feeling trends, and Soft Wall. The product is provided as-is. We may change features, prices, or availability with reasonable notice on the site.
Terms.s2Body: You must provide a real email you control and keep your password secret. You are responsible for activity on your account. Do not use the service to store illegal content, harass others, or attempt to break into the app, other accounts, or the admin backend.
Terms.s3Body: Paid plans and sticker purchases are billed by Stripe. Taxes, receipts, and card details are handled there. You can cancel in the Stripe customer portal; access continues until the end of the paid period unless we say otherwise. Manual plan changes in admin do not create a Stripe charge.
Terms.s4Body: You keep the rights to the reviews you write. By saving them you give us a license to store and display them to you. If you pin a week to Soft Wall, you allow other Soft+ members to read that week, comment, and place stickers. Sharing is optional and can be reversed. Do not post other people’s private information. Soft Wall has a short etiquette page (Guidelines) — be kind, skip spam, and only share weeks you mean to share.
Terms.s5Body: The service is a writing tool, not medical, legal, or therapeutic advice. To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for lost reviews, downtime, or indirect damages. Our total liability for a claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim, or zero if you are on Free.
Terms.s6Body: You may stop using the service and request account deletion. We may suspend accounts that break these terms or harm the community wall. The privacy policy explains how data is handled after deletion. These terms are governed by the laws applicable to the operator unless a mandatory consumer law says otherwise.

Guidelines.title: Soft Wall guidelines
Guidelines.lead: A short, soft etiquette for Soft Wall. Not a rulebook with teeth — just how neighbors stay kind here.
Guidelines.s1Body: Your weekly review stays private until you choose to pin it. Sharing is a gentle yes, not a default. You can take a note off the wall whenever you like.
Guidelines.s2Body: Comments and stickers are little praise, not debate. Assume good intent. No insults, piled-on criticism, or pressure to explain a quiet week.
Guidelines.s3Body: Soft Wall is not a billboard. Skip ads, affiliate blasts, repeated identical notes, or anything that crowds the corkboard for attention.
Guidelines.s4Title: Share only what you mean to share
Guidelines.s4Body: Pin a week you are comfortable letting Soft+ neighbors read. Leave out other people’s private details. If a note feels too raw tomorrow, unpin it — that is allowed.
Guidelines.s5Body: If something feels unkind or out of place, Soft+ members can leave a soft flag for operators. We may hide notes that break these guidelines. We prefer a quiet fix over a loud fight.
Guidelines.s6Body: This is a corkboard, not a feed. Slow is fine. Silence is fine. Come when the kettle's on — leave when you're done.
